svg.title: Rounded conductor in a uniform field
svg.desc: Computed field lines around a neutral, rounded oblong conductor placed in a field that was uniform and pointing to the right. Far away the lines are straight and evenly spaced. Near the conductor they bend so that they meet its surface at right angles: lines crowd into the left end, where negative charge is induced, and crowd out of the right end, where positive charge is induced. Along the long flat sides the lines are sparse and few charges sit there, so the field near the sides is small. There is no field inside the conductor.
